subject: Finalize reference rights and embargo window for HelioPilot Order Form
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@heliopilot.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@heliopilot.com, Ava Patel <ava.patel@heliopilot.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft order form — publicity and embargo question

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for sending the draft. Our legal team flagged two items around publicity: the blanket reference right in Section 9 and the 30-day embargo on press after launch. We can agree to a customer reference but need clearer limits on what Redwood can publish and an explicit approval step for quotes. Also would you consider a 45-day embargo rather than 30 to cover our beta milestones?

I attached the redline our counsel proposed (HelioPilot_OrderForm_Redlines.docx). Can your legal team take a look and confirm whether Redwood can accept the approval gating and the longer embargo?

Appreciate it,
Sofia

Attachment: HelioPilot_OrderForm_Redlines.docx (document, 84KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@heliopilot.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft order form — publicity and embargo question

Hi Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround and the annotated doc. Looping in Stephanie (contracts) and Rishi (legal) from our side to evaluate. Initial thoughts:

- We typically ask for a perpetual, non-exclusive reference right limited to a short factual description (company name, logo, one-liner). We avoid unlimited testimonial quotes without pre-approval.
- A 45-day embargo is not unreasonable for a joint launch; we normally default to 30 days but can be flexible if there is clear launch timing tied to product milestones.
- The approval gating you propose for quotes is fine; we can add explicit language that Redwood must obtain written approval for any customer-attributed quote and will allow up to 5 business days for review.

Stephanie/Rishi — please review Sofia's redlines (attached) and respond with edits we can propose back to HelioPilot. Key questions for legal: are we ok with adding a 5-business-day approval window and a 45-day embargo? Also confirm if the reference right should be time-limited or perpetual.

Next steps:
1) Rishi/Stephanie to send a counter-redline by EOD Monday.
2) Tessa to consolidate and send to HelioPilot with a brief rationale for changes.

Thanks,
Tessa

Attachment: MSA_publicity_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 14KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Draft order form — publicity and embargo question

Tessa / Stephanie — I reviewed HelioPilot's redlines and drafted counter language. High-level summary of legal position: 

1) Reference right: we will accept a perpetual, non-exclusive right to use the HelioPilot name and logo in a factual manner (customer list, case study mention), but any quote or testimonial that attributes words to HelioPilot requires prior written approval. We will carve out a limited exception for short, factual descriptions in product collateral (e.g., "HelioPilot uses Redwood to...") that do not assign subjective endorsement.

2) Embargo window: we can agree to a 45-day embargo only if HelioPilot commits to providing a launch date in writing and coordinating with our communications team. Otherwise, we prefer 30 days. Suggest language: "Either party may request an extension of the embargo by written notice not less than 10 days prior to expiration, subject to mutual agreement."

3) Logo files and marks: we propose a usage matrix (see attached MSA_publicity_matrix.xlsx) that limits logo placement and requires Redwood to follow HelioPilot brand guidelines; we will add the reciprocal requirement for HelioPilot to follow Redwood brand guidelines.

I attached a tracked-redline of the Order Form and the proposed clause language. If you want, I can prepare a short email to Sofia summarizing these points and attach the redline.

Regards,
Rishi

Attachment: Redwood_counter_redline_HelioPilot.docx (document, 62KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@heliopilot.com>
Cc: Ava Patel <ava.patel@heliopilot.com>, legal@heliopilot.com, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft order form — publicity and embargo question

Sofia — thank you and your counsel for the clear feedback. Attaching our redline and a short summary of the changes we propose:

- Reference rights: We accept a perpetual, non-exclusive right to state HelioPilot is a customer. Any quote or customer-attributed testimonial will require prior written approval.
- Embargo: We propose the flexible approach Rishi outlined — default 30 days, ability to agree to 45 days if HelioPilot confirms a launch date and coordinates with Redwood comms; either party may request an extension with 10 days notice for mutual agreement.
- Logo usage: See the attached publicity matrix outlining permitted uses. We will follow HelioPilot brand guidelines and expect reciprocal brand usage requirements for Redwood.

Please review the attached "Redwood_counter_redline_HelioPilot.docx" and let us know if HelioPilot can accept those points. If they look good, we can incorporate them into the final Order Form and move the deal to signatures.

Proposed next steps:
- HelioPilot confirms acceptance (or sends one round of minor edits) by EOD Friday, Apr 13.
- If further negotiation is needed, we schedule a 30-minute call between legal teams on Apr 15.

Thanks again — we're excited to get HelioPilot onboarded.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
